profile.story: Aisha Rahman registered Verdant Health Coaching in March 2026 after eleven years as a hospital dietitian. There is a website, an Instagram account, a logo and three pro-bono clients. There is no revenue, no pricing, no offer written down, and no business bank activity beyond a domain and a subscription. She booked the diagnostic on the strength of a free class and returned an intake with four required questions blank; the intensive was cut short after Block 2 when it became clear there was not yet a business to diagnose.

edge_cases: THE INCOMPLETE CASE — the file is deliberately unfinished and must fail the gate loudly rather than quietly produce a thin report
four required intake questions (q1, q2, q3, q8) are absent as keys, not answered as 'unknown'
most remaining answers are the literal string 'unknown', which must never be coerced to zero
only 12 of 30 indicators resolved — under the 25 threshold — and Systems (3) and Leverage (3) both fall under the four-indicator pillar minimum
no opportunities, no primary constraint, no annual cost, nothing Demonstrated or Documented

intake.q45: Nothing is automated. There is nothing to automate yet.

blockNotes.b1: Aisha registered the LLC in March 2026 after eleven years as a hospital dietitian. There is a website, an Instagram account with 480 followers and three pro-bono clients she is seeing weekly. There is no paid client, no price, no written offer. She did not complete q1, q2, q3 or q8 — she said she 'did not know how to answer what the business does yet, because it keeps changing'. That is an honest answer and it is also the finding.
blockNotes.b2: Asked where inquiries come from and what happens to them: three DMs in the last month, all answered within a day, none converted because there was nothing to convert them to. No price exists. No offer exists on paper. We stopped the session here by agreement — going further would have produced scores about a business that has not been built yet.
blockNotes.b3: Not reached. The systems block was not run.
blockNotes.b4: Not reached. No repetitive-work inventory was taken, no loaded rates were collected.
blockNotes.b5: Not reached. No continuity, contract or risk questions were asked.
blockNotes.b6: Advisor note on disposition: this is not a Growth & AI Diagnostic engagement. The fee should be credited toward a Constraint Session focused on offer definition and pricing, and the intake reissued once there is a paid client. Nothing in this file should be released as a report.

P1.note: Three Instagram DMs in the last month is the whole of it. No sources named, no counts kept, no tracking of any kind. Anchor 0 verbatim.
P1.why_not_higher: Anchor 1 needs sources named from memory; there is one channel and no sense of what it produces.

P2.note: Inquiries land in one place — Instagram DM — and were answered within a day. No log, no system, and nothing to answer them with.
P2.why_not_higher: Anchor 2 needs some capture; there is none, and the volume is three.

P3.note: Not scored — the session ended in Block 2 and there is no follow-up behaviour yet to observe.

P4.note: Not scored — no sale has ever been attempted, so there is no conversion process to describe at any anchor.

P5.note: There is no price. Asked directly what a coaching engagement costs: 'I have not decided.' The three current clients are pro bono.
P5.why_not_higher: Anchor 1 needs a price that has existed and not moved; there has never been one.

P6.note: One undifferentiated coaching offer described verbally and differently twice in the same conversation. Nothing written down, no tiers, no add-ons.
P6.why_not_higher: Anchor 2 needs add-ons offered ad hoc; there is one service and it has no definition.

P7.note: Not scored — no customer has ever bought, so there is no retention or reactivation behaviour to score.

P8.note: Nobody owns marketing or sales because there is one person and no defined activity. No numbers of any kind exist.
P8.why_not_higher: Anchor 1 needs the owner acting as de facto marketing and sales with numbers scattered somewhere; there are no numbers anywhere.

P9.note: Not scored — no revenue and no cost base, so gross margin has no subject.

P10.note: q20: 'Tax time only.' q19: cash is not reviewed regularly. No bookkeeping, no accounting system (q41 reads 'none'), no P&L.
P10.why_not_higher: Anchor 1 needs a bookkeeper keeping the books; there is no bookkeeper and no books.

S1.note: One person, no employees or contractors (q10), everything needs her by construction.
S1.why_not_higher: Anchor 1 needs routine tasks delegated; there is nobody to delegate to.

S2.note: Sole founder with no employees and three weekly pro-bono client sessions she personally delivers. Nothing continues in her absence.
S2.why_not_higher: Anchor 1 needs the business to run about a week; it runs zero days.

S3.note: Not scored — the session ended before Block 3 and no selling has occurred.

S4.note: Not scored. This is the case Rubrics v2 §5 would allow as N/A for having no employees, but the file was not completed and the advisor did not record a reason, so it is left unresolved rather than claimed.

S5.note: Nothing is written down. Asked whether any part of how she runs a client engagement exists on paper: 'It is all in my head, I have only done it three times.'
S5.why_not_higher: Anchor 1 needs a few checklists to exist; there are none.

S6.note: Not scored — Block 4 was not reached and q39 and q40 were left unknown.

S7.note: Not scored — q31 answered 'Don't know' and there is no delivery volume to observe.

S8.note: Not scored — no revenue, so there is no customer share of revenue to measure. Not N/A: the indicator will apply as soon as there is a first paying client.

S9.note: Not scored — q12 left unknown and no revenue exists to be predictable or otherwise.

S10.note: Not scored — Block 5 was not reached; contracts, insurance and continuity were never discussed.

L1.note: Not scored — q41 was partly answered but the systems block was not run and nothing was seen.

L2.note: Not scored — q42 left unknown, no tour taken.

L3.note: Not scored — q43 left unknown; there is no data and no report to trust or distrust.

L4.note: Not scored — q44 left unknown, no repetitive-work inventory was taken.

L5.note: Not scored — q45 says nothing is automated, but the block was not run and this was not confirmed against anything.

L6.note: q46: drafting, research and marketing content. She writes every Instagram caption and her client handouts with ChatGPT and described the routine unprompted. Individual and undefined, but real and daily.
L6.why_not_higher: Anchor 3 needs AI inside one or two defined workflows; nothing is defined because nothing in the business is defined.

L7.note: Not scored — q47 left unknown. Worth flagging for the reissued intake: she is a former clinician putting client health information into consumer tools and nobody has asked her about it.

L8.note: Not scored — q48 left unknown and the systems block was not run.

L9.note: q58: 'Pockets of capability.' One person, self-taught, comfortable adopting tools quickly — the Squarespace site, Calendly and the AI writing routine were all set up by her without help.
L9.why_not_higher: Anchor 3 needs the team trained on the core tools; there has been no training and no core tool set to be trained on.

L10.note: Appetite is high — she paid for this engagement out of savings. q55: 'Uncertain', and q49 was left unknown, so no budget and no hours have been set aside for anything.
L10.why_not_higher: Anchor 2 needs capacity that is limited but real; there is no revenue to fund it and no allocated time, only willingness.
